cost-map.description: A model is missing, priced wrong, or has a stale capability flag or context limit

llm-translation.description: A provider returns the wrong shape, drops a param, or breaks on streaming, tools, images, reasoning

routing.description: Wrong deployment picked, fallbacks, retries, cooldowns, model group aliases, the auto router

caching.description: Response cache served or skipped wrongly, Redis or semantic cache misconfigured, key collisions

proxy-core.description: Proxy startup, config.yaml, health checks, middleware, timeouts, non-chat route handlers

proxy-auth.description: Keys, JWT, SSO, SCIM, roles and memberships accepted or rejected wrongly

management.description: Creating, updating, listing or deleting keys, teams, users, orgs, models, credentials, tags

spend-tracking.description: Spend amount wrong or zero, spend logs missing or duplicated, cost on the wrong key or team

budgets-rate-limits.description: 429s or budget blocks fired wrongly, budgets not resetting, tpm/rpm counted wrong

db.description: Migrations, Prisma connections, slow queries, unbounded tables, schema drift

logging.description: Callbacks, Langfuse, Datadog, OTel, Prometheus, alerting, redaction

guardrails.description: Guardrail blocked or missed wrongly, PII masking, policies, moderation providers

mcp.description: MCP servers, tool calls, tool authorisation, OAuth to MCP servers

agents.description: Agent endpoints, the A2A gateway, the agentic loop, skills, workflows

vector-stores.description: Vector stores, knowledge bases, RAG ingestion, file search, vector store backends

passthrough.description: A raw provider URL forwarded through the proxy behaves differently from the provider

ui.description: A page in the Admin UI shows the wrong thing, a form does not save, a button does nothing

sdk.description: The Python package itself: install, wheels, dependency pins, imports, exceptions, token_counter

deploy.description: Docker images, Helm charts, compose files, Terraform; the pip package is sdk

docs.description: The docs say something the code does not do, or miss something it does

unknown.description: The issue does not say enough to place it

bug.description: Something in our code does the wrong thing

feature.description: Something we do not do yet, including a provider or model we never supported

question.description: A local setup problem with nothing yet shown broken in our code

p0.description: We broke it or it is bleeding: regression, leak, endpoint down, wrong cache hit, security, data loss

p1.description: A supported path does the wrong thing and there is no real way around it

p2.description: Broken, but a workaround keeps the feature working or only a corner case hits it

p3.description: Nothing is broken: a feature, a question, a docs gap, cosmetics

small.description: At most half a day: one file, reproduction included, clear fix

medium.description: One to three days: one subsystem, reproduction has to be built

large.description: More than three days: new provider, migration, auth change, needs design

template.description: Required sections of the issue template are missing or empty

version.description: No LiteLLM version anywhere in the issue

repro.description: A bug with no command, output or screenshot to reproduce it
